SigmaQuest: 
- My game was working properly but had security issues. I had to move some functions from the front end to the back end server. This required significant changes. 
- Yesterday I got the server running again with updates, and reworked the front end components. Today I have been trying to debug. 
-Current issues are with payment validation. Once the back end verifies the tx on chain, the front end should start the game for the user. I keep receiving errors regarding cors and timeout. 
- I thought I had it fixed, but then the game started skipping validation altogether 😃 I just rolled back changes and am trying a different approach.
The explorer API. My server checks every 30 seconds for the txid created in the front end
Pretty much. Once verified it creates a session for the user on the back end. Front end is looking for sessions associated to the user ID constantly
I think you've tagged the wrong person boss
